# Dance Event Viewer

> Dance Event Viewer (danceeventviewer.net) is a free calendar of partner-dance and social-dance
> events across the Southern United States — West Coast Swing, ballroom, Latin, country swing,
> line dance, and more — centered on the Pensacola, FL and Mobile, AL areas, with national
> events included. Each event lists schedule, venue, cost, and dance style.

## Main pages

- [Event calendar (list, calendar, and map views)](https://danceeventviewer.net/dance-event-viewer/)
- [Submit an event](https://danceeventviewer.net/dance-event-viewer/submit-event.html)

## Event pages

- [Sitemap of all individual event pages](https://danceeventviewer.net/sitemap.xml): every event
  has its own page under /e/ with schedule, venue, cost, and schema.org Event markup.

## Notes

- Event data is curated and updated continually from organizer announcements.
- Recurring events list their pattern (for example "Every Tuesday" or "3rd Saturday").
